note: Lateral area 37 (posterior ITG/MTG). No Julich v3.1 cytoarchitectonic area; the territory is covered by GapMap-Temporal-to-Parietal.
Medial area 37 (medial fusiform/lingual boundary). No Julich v3.1 area equated with it; CoS1 and Ph1-Ph3 are neighbours but not established equivalents.
Inferior temporal gyrus BA20. No Julich v3.1 cytoarchitectonic area; GapMap-Frontal-to-Temporal-II / GapMap-Temporal-to-Parietal cover it.
Middle temporal gyrus BA21. No Julich v3.1 area; covered by GapMap-Temporal-to-Parietal.
Ectorhinal/perirhinal BA36. No Julich v3.1 area 35/36; EC and the parahippocampal Ph1-Ph3 / CoS1 areas are neighbours, not equivalents.
Temporal pole BA38. No Julich v3.1 area; covered by GapMap-Frontal-to-Temporal-I.
Posterior cingulate BA23: no Julich v3.1 area.
Posterior cingulate/precuneal BA31: no Julich v3.1 area; 7M (SPL) is a precuneal neighbour, not an equivalent.
Dorsolateral prefrontal BA9. Julich v3.1 SFG2-SFG4 / MFG4-MFG5 are new areas not defined as BA9 equivalents; GapMap-Frontal-I covers the remainder.
Mid-dorsolateral prefrontal BA46 (MFG). Julich MFG1/MFG2 are posterior MFG areas not equated with BA46; GapMap-Frontal-I covers the remainder.
